responsibility: Implements the Arm-specific gcc driver helper for `-march=native`, `-mcpu=native`, and `-mtune=native`. It reads host CPU identification data, matches implementer and part numbers against the generated native CPU tables from `arm-native.h`, and returns the concrete `-march=`, `-mcpu=`, or `-mtune=` option string to substitute in the driver, with fallback to configure-time default options when runtime detection fails.
